title: Container state and immutable identity
summary: Container inspect records lifecycle state for an immutable ID. Running, paused, restarting, exited and dead require different checks. A reused name can identify a replacement rather than the incident instance.
checks: Repeat inspect for the exact full ID and verify its start/restart cohort.
Compare declared instance topology with an independent application route or database contract.
limitations: Running does not prove functional health. A missing ID does not show why it disappeared.
